# Recorder

[![Build Status](https://app.travis-ci.com/lugobots/recorder.svg?token=mDEc2tERjg7thJWDqCxN&branch=master)](https://app.travis-ci.com/lugobots/recorder)

This library used to be part of a service called reporter, that used to listen to the game events and record the game.

However, as this process become necessary from inside the Game Server, the server was deprecated, and the left over became
the Recorder lib.
